data.notes: PGG V0.182 panel: +195 HP, +90 Stamina, +17% ADF, +2 Damage Reduction, +5% Damage Reduction Factor, +10% Block Regen, +3 Block Points. The user stat bar (2026-09-26) matches: Block Points 5.95 = katana 2.95 + 3; Block Regen 1.85x = 1.75 + 0.10 (additive); Damage Reduction +2; DR Factor 1.05x. 17% fits the additive ADF pool only if another +1.5% source exists (unidentified 5th item?); if not, Himejima would be 18.5%.
